title: Unit Event — Desperate Times?! Island Panic!

meta.Outline: After a very successful performance at the music hall, Wonderlands×Showtime gets to take a cruiser to their next ambassadorial show venue. But what are they going to do when they all wake up on a desert island after running into a storm...?!

rows.Line: se_event_island_2022_009

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Ugh... My head hurts... Did I catch a cold or something?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My body feels so heavy... No, hang on... It's my clothes... I feel like I got drenched in a rainstorm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And that sound... Am I hearing waves...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But why? Where am I right now...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Where...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where am I...?!
se_event_island_2022_009

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Sunny-sunny-fun-fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Emu!
Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene, good morning.
I'm hearing so many more birds than usual... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! It's the ocean!
It's so beautiful! And the sun's shining really bright!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But what are we doing in a place like this...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's what I want to know... But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aha! There you two are!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui! Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We became worried after losing sight of you. Thank goodness you're both okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Not to mention that we lost our phones, so we had no way of contacting you.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I'm glad everyone's safe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Robo-Nene, you're okay. Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She took a good dunking in the ocean, so we should be careful not to ask too much of her.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But to think that we'd end up in a place like this. The cruiser seems to have run aground too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The cruiser...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait... That reminds me...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: So, we have the details regarding your next ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Where do we get to go next♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah. We've already gone to the United States, so don't be surprised if we're asked to go to the other side of the world or somewhere out in the Milky Way!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, that'll surprise me plenty.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Okay...?
Anyway, here is your next assignment.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: It'll be on... A desert island.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A... A desert island?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: That's right. It also goes by the name of “the dreaded isle”. Apparently, it's crawling with strange creatures.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: On top of that, just nearby, there's an area of that sea known as the “sinister square” where many vessels get shipwrecked before reaching their destination...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Crawling with strange creatures... The sinister square... Hehe. All very interesting indeed.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why are we doing a show there?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also, how do you expect the audience to get to such a dangerous place?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke, you've taken your joke far enough.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Haha. You all fell right for it.
I felt that your minds needed a bit of stimulation and I thought this surprise would do nicely.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means we won't be going to a desert island...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why the tone of disappointment?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, where are we going?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
A hall in Okinawa.
The venue itself is fairly old and doesn't seat that many people, but is adored by all the locals.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We've been meaning to have you perform in various regions since it's a good way to expand our customer base, but the question of “where” has always been an issue...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But the other day, the owner of a venue that met our needs decided to contact us after seeing your performance at the music hall and being incredibly moved by it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After seeing our performance...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, there's one other thing.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You'll be going there on my beloved cruiser that was just refurbished for the first time in several years with yours truly at the helm.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wh-What...?!
That sounds so luxurious!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Because it is.
So thank your stars.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! It's been so long since the last time I went on your cruiser! I only got to go on it once!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And you kept refusing to let me go on it again after that no matter how many times I asked...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Because you kept trying to reach out into the ocean or stand on the gunwale while its engines were running.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But this is your reward for doing your best as ambassadors up to this point.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
What?
No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?! Is that true?!
Thank you so much, Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Fine, I suppose you all deserve a little reward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's been so long... What do you guys wanna do on the cruiser?! Oh, how about some fishing? We can have a contest to see who can catch the most fish!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Fishing, huh? That does sound fun.
We could even cook and eat them on the spot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, no! We won't be on vacation!
We're traveling south because we've been asked to put smiles on the locals' faces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're going to overwhelm them by putting on the best show imaginable and reaching new heights!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Reach new heights, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We were asked to do a performance because of how our show at the music hall went... But I have to think Tsukasa's the main reason.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He usually plays boisterous characters with a bit of bravado to them, but playing a role that requires tact allowed him to grow some as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That really startled me, and we're in the same troupe. I have to think the audience was totally blown away by his performance.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? What's the matter, Nene?
Is there something on my face?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to try my best for our next performance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Since I want to be in musicals like Ms. Kazamatsuri...!)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Anyway, I believe that's everything.
Shosuke will let you know when and where to meet, so please be sure to let us know when you know what you're going to be performing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Understood.
So, what shall we do...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's start brainstorming right now!
We're gonna be in Okinawa, so a show that involves lots and lots of fruits might be fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That alone won't make much sense to the audience... So, let's head backstage and start planning things in earnest!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, now I remember...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We were all on the cruiser and it started raining and gusting really hard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And when I woke up, I was here...
<Tsukasa?! Where are you?!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That voice... Miku?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, look over there!
The thing sticking out of the sand... Isn't that Tsukasa's phone?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
I thought I lost it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Miku's voice seems to be coming from there too. Let's head over to retrieve it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, you're together! Thank goodness!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Miku was very worried since we couldn't reach most of your phones, and because we couldn't see you even though we managed to reach yours, Tsukasa.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We came to take a look after we started fearing that something terrible had happened.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see... It likely didn't help that my phone shorted after taking a swim in the ocean...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mine too! It won't turn on at all!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same with mine...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So by some miracle, mine survived...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I don't understand.
Why can't all of you use your phones?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were heading towards the venue where we'd be performing, but it seems we were thrown overboard after getting caught in a storm.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: <What?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I have a feeling that electricity's going to be hard to come by around here, so it's only a matter of time until the battery on Tsukasa's phone runs out...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh no! Does that mean we suddenly won't be able to talk to them anymore?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm also worried, but it's the unfortunate truth. Regardless, we plan to help all of you while we can.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Wait, that reminds me...
Wasn't Emu's older brother supposed to be at the helm of this cruiser of yours?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Where is he right now?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Good question...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we haven't seen him at all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What if...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sho...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosukeee!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What do we do...?
What if we can't find him...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I don't see him anywhere around here...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We may want to go back to where the cruiser ran aground since I'm fairly certain he was still at the helm when it happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, if we go back there, we might just... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Eep!
Wh-What is this...?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Did you find something, Nene?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, I found this enormous pile of seaweed...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Seaweed?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh...
That's quite a lot of seaweed.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But isn't it kinda strange...?
I mean, it almost looks like... A person...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it does. If what I'm imagining is correct, there's someone wrapped up in all this seaweed.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Look! There's a hand sticking out a little... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The life line on this person's hand's so long... It has to be Shosuke!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke's Voice
rows.Line: A-All of you... Hurry up and get this seaweed off... My mouth tastes so salty...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...
We need to help him fast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right!
Everyone, let's get this seaweed off him!!
se_event_island_2022_012

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I thought I was a goner...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Pulse and pupils normal.
No fractures or cavities. You have very healthy teeth. I see that you brush them with care each day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you're all safe as well.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Unfortunately, we're in a tough predicament. To think that we'd end up on a completely uninhabited island.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But the cruiser seems fine...
Can't we just set sail now that the weather's cleared up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, about that...
I had a quick look at the engine and it pains me to report that it appears broken.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
M-My cruiser...
I waited three years to have it refurbished...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As such, we currently have no way of getting off this island...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're kidding, right...? That means...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our fun and exciting desert island survival adventure's about to start!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: This can't be happening!!
Coast

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have to survive on a desert island...? You've gotta be kidding...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's something you see often on TV, but the prospect of actually getting to experience such a situation...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hang on... You're enjoying this, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: New encounters and experiences are always exciting, are they not?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
However...
Right now, time is not on our side.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Yes.
We will not make it in time for the show if we do not hurry.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were scheduled to arrive at the hall today and rehearse, then go live tomorrow afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, so that means we'll be okay as long as we get out of here somehow?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: If that's even possible...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We can't get a cellular signal here, so it's likely that nobody knows about us being stranded.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And with the cruiser's engine on the fritz, we're currently out of options.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: My attempts to capture a signal were also fruitless. Possibly due to the seawater, several errors arose when I tried to use my communications equipment.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I apologize for not being able to help.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, Robo-Nene, you don't have to apologize!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, she's right.
We appreciate the fact that you made a sincere effort!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
B-But what do we do...?
At this rate, if we can't get ahold of anyone...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
We won't be able to leave...
And we'll be stuck here forever...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I seriously doubt that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: The venue staff know that we're supposed to arrive today. The same goes for where we're scheduled to lodge.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They'll surely make the connection that something's wrong and send out help if we don't arrive without prior notice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: R-Right...!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: However, there's no guarantee that we'll be saved in time for the show.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone's really looking forward to seeing our show, right...? Is it not possible for us to just do it tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We may end up running late, but I promise that you'll get to do your show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I know we're in a tough spot, but I have a duty to get you to your destination and ensure that you're able to put on the best performance possible.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: So, for the time being, focus on surviving until help comes for us.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I'm going to see if I can get ahold of anyone using the radio on the cruiser. The rest of you should take a quick look to see what's on this island, but try not to venture too far.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Also, let me know if you see any ships.
That's going to be the quickest way out of this mess.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, there he goes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, Rui, can't you take a look at that radio?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I could, but finding food and shelter seems like a priority now since Shosuke said that he's going to do something about it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right. I'm somewhat worried about whether or not our show's going to happen, but for now, let's place our faith in him...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We may not get there on schedule, but he promised that we'd get to do it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So let's do as he said and focus on surviving until help arrives!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree.
We'll get through this as long as we work together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Let's do our best!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, it's not like we have any other choice...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But how long is it gonna take for someone to come and help us...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't even know how we're supposed to gather food and water... Are we actually gonna be able to survive here...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's really starting to feel like a survival adventure now!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What the?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: G-Geez, you scared us...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Oh, did I scare you?
I thought it was okay for me to come out since Emu's brother isn't here anymore.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You could've given us a little heads up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Haha! I'm sorry!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<But you guys really are amazing...
I mean, you're on a desert island. That means no people at all, right?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If I were in your shoes right now, I'm not sure that I could be so optimistic...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Really?
I think a desert island adventure would be really fun☆>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <To be fair, we're only able to say these things because we're in a safe place...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, I know!
Can't you guys just jump on over to SEKAI if things get sticky?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You'd have a safe place to wait until help arrives!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That already crossed my mind, but we can't just leave Shosuke here all by himself...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, right...
I guess that means you guys have to stay there...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Here...?
In this place...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It's only natural for you to be worried. Just imagining what could be lurking out there on this island is somewhat terrifying.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <However, I have a good feeling that this experience will turn into something invaluable later on!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Something invaluable...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes! I mean, you don't get to enjoy anything this thrilling by going about your business as usual, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Which is why I believe this is a rare opportunity to add some spice to your lives!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I'm with her!
There's no way adventuring somewhere you've never been before won't be fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I agree. This could end up being a good experience! It's not every day that you get to do anything like this!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it's not gonna be all fun and games...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just finding something that's edible is going to be hard...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, seawater's the last thing you're supposed to drink in these situations, right?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it's salt water, so it's only going to make you thirstier.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Really?! I didn't know that!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <That means you guys have to also find fresh water! There's so much to do! Almost too much to handle!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There is quite a bit to do, but isn't that also a good thing?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It won't be easy, but doing your best by working together as a team to get through this will do wonders for you in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wonders? For us...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, that's right! Just think about it.
What good will come of sitting around waiting for help to arrive?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So, wouldn't it be better to get in the spirit of things and enjoy the moment?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, MEIKO's absolutely right!
A star must be able to smile and have fun regardless of the situation they may be in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
I think having fun's the best thing we can do right now too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Have fun...? In this situation...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't honestly say that I'm on the same page as them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I do agree that there's no point in feeling down and out.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As worried as I am, I should try to be a little more optimistic...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, let's take what MEIKO said to heart and enjoy this situation while also doing what we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what do you wanna do first?!
We need water, right? How about we look for some coconuts and make some juice?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Coconuts could help keep us hydrated... But there might not be enough for all of us, so shouldn't we try to find a freshwater spring or something instead?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa and I even came across a cave when we were looking for a good place to call a base camp, so we should be able to take shelter in the event the weather doesn't hold up.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, finding drinkable water's the next thing on our list... Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Haha!
Was that you, Emu? Your tummy made such a cute sound just now!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I had a big breakfast, but I guess I'm already getting hungry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And it's already past noon.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: It may be best to also forage for some food.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
In terms of what this place has to offer... I suppose catching fish is our best option, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Catching fish... That sounds fun.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But how are you guys gonna do that?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm pretty sure our fishing rods all went overboard!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we head into this bit of forest to forage for food and find a source of water?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, good idea!
I bet there's tons of food in there!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
This forest...
It's probably full of bugs... But there's no time for that right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, let's go with that plan.
And we can always make a contraption for collecting water if we have trouble finding a decent source.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wait, you can make one?!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can gather up water vapor by digging a hole in the ground, laying down a tarp and making sure it stays put by laying down some stones.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. That sounds remarkably simple.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Robo-Nene, mind gathering up some of the other things we'll need to set up camp? Once you've done that, please go help Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, Robo-Nene's not coming with us...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Remember how she said some errors were popping up? I'm worried that having to maneuver around this terrain will only serve to exacerbate that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay...
I wanted her to come with us, but I guess we don't have a choice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Will you be alright by yourself, Robo-Nene?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, I will be fine.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will let Shosuke know about where you entered the forest. Please take care as you explore.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Alright, we're finally about to go in! This is gonna be awesome♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We'll keep an eye out for any possible dangers while you forage for food, but please do be careful since we don't know what's going to be waiting for us in there.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Exploring a forest on a desert island sounded scary at first, but it might not be so bad since we have Miku and the others here with us...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(At the same time, KAITO's right.
It's probably really dangerous in there, so we need to be extra careful.)
Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought we'd be fine when we went in since we'd be together...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But this place is more jungle than forest... How are we supposed to find anything to eat in here...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! That birdie's wings were so loud!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<I've never seen such a big bird before!
It's really starting to feel like a desert island now♪>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! Be glad that it wasn't some sort of fierce beast!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, we sort of just waltzed right in...
Do you think there are any dangerous animals roaming around in here?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I doubt we'll see any lions or tigers, but we may want to watch out for snakes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They don't usually go after people and the odds are slim, but we definitely want to avoid being bitten.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, so just dash at full speed if we see a snake?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is it really gonna be that easy...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This jungle certainly feels undisturbed. Just finding our way through this terrain is going to be challenging...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<This is wonderful!
It's turning into such an exciting adventure♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, check out this vine!
Do you think we can use it to swing between trees while shouting, Ahh-ahah-ahah♪...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure that little vine can support you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You'll have to find a stronger one to hang from it seems...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I can't believe how upbeat you guys can be while in such a dark place... I mean, who knows what's waiting to jump out at us...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, that's why this is so fun!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
An unexpected adventure in an unknown land! I couldn't be more excited!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I'm super excited too☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'll probably never understand why...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But the natural world does feel very lush. I'm seeing a cornucopia of things we can possibly eat!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
For instance, these mushrooms!
It's grown so big. I bet it's delicious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's marvelous...
It's so cute how it's all white too.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But some mushrooms are poisonous, so it's probably not a good idea to touch them, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, don't underestimate me. I am fully aware of that fact.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Poisonous mushrooms tend to be very vibrant and easy to spot, but this one is beautiful albeit modest and subdued...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which means it must be edible!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How exactly did you arrive on that...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that appears to be an edible white amanita.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You can tell, Rui?!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa! Tsukasa was right!
That's so cool!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah.
I knew my eyes would not deceive me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, there's a very similar species of amanita that's been nicknamed “the destroying angel” because of how poisonous it is.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And it's difficult to differentiate between those species...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Call it a 50-50 chance.
Imagine the thrill when you try to eat it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And if it turns out to be poisonous...?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Okay, no more mushrooms!
Let's find something else to eat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This guy...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hm? Where's Emu?
She was here just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: She said something about seeing some nice berries hanging from a tree, but I don't see her anywhere.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, is she gonna be okay...?
What are we supposed to do if she gets separated?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Shosuke even told us to not venture too far, so if something did happen to her...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
R-Right.
We should find her and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
D-Don't jump out at us like that!
You almost made my heart stop!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where were you? Also, why are you covered in leaves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I saw some yummy-looking berries over there and discovered a grassy tunnel when I leaned down to pick them up.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A grassy tunnel?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There was all this grass that was as tall as Rui, but there was this one part where it looked like someone had already gone through...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like someone had already gone through...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I went down it to see where it went and found all these raspberries and little things that looked like fruits, so I decided to pick them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, Emu, excellent work!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I hereby name you the captain of the berry-hunting brigade. Let us hope that you strike it rich again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sir, yes, sir!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You guys should have plenty to eat now thanks to Emu, right?!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we should.
I even found some wild herbs that appear to be edible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, a bucket-load too!
What do you think we can make using all this stuff?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hang on...
I'm seeing some things here that clearly don't look edible. What's with them...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I picked up some other things while I was picking those herbs because I thought they'll come in handy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, this sturdy-looking vine may work as a nice prop if we ever end up doing a jungle-themed show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That explains why you were digging around in some strange places. You were looking for these things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're not thinking about taking them home, are you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Haha!
Emu the free spirit and Rui the director with a wonderful imagination seem to be enjoying themselves!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It's good that you have a bucket full of food, but are you sure it's going to be enough? You'll need to feed five if you include Emu's brother...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah, wild herbs and berries don't sound very filling, you know? I'd probably be hungry again after a little while...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we still don't have anything that we can call a staple, but finding one isn't going to be easy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
True.
Something packed with carbohydrates would be ideal, like rice, but in terms of where we are...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry to interrupt this conversation, but I thought I saw something pass through those bushes just now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? I didn't see anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I only caught a glimpse, so I may be wrong...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's it!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wah!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Emu, what's wrong?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I've got it.
I found something that can act as a replacement for bread and rice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Up! Look up!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, yeah...!
Aren't those bananas growing from that tree?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
They're usually a dessert, but they might just do for our main entree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and filling too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, we're in agreement!
Once again, captain of the berry-hunting brigade, well done!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! I did it♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm not sure if bananas count as berries...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Also, the bunches that seem ripe for eating are very high up. Is there a way to get to those?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Can't you guys just jump up and get them?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What?
That high up...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It won't be easy, but it's worth a try...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, leave this to the future star whose legs have been conditioned by Rui's directing! Watch as I soar!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, wait...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, wait!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Zzz... Zzz...
You can do it, Tsukasa...>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There! Drats! Now! This time!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Arrrgh... It's no use!!
No matter how many times I try, I can't get close!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I'm so sorry!
Now that I'm seeing them up close, they're a lot higher than I thought!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I knew it...
There's no way for us to get up that high.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm gonna give it a try!
Here I go!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whee!
se_event_island_2022_001
se_event_island_2022_002
se_event_island_2022_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that!
Emu, that was a beautiful triple jump!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Grr... Darn it...
I touched them! I was so close!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They look very healthy and mature, so we'll need to do more than just touch them to bring them down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, I have a feeling that you'll have to find a way to tear the entire bunch off somehow.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Hmm...
Isn't there any way to do that? I mean, you were lucky enough to find these, so...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, what if you lifted someone up by putting them on your shoulders or something?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good idea!
Rui and I could try lifting each other!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No, that still wouldn't be enough.
There are four of us, so Tsukasa, you and I can act as the base...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
And have Nene on our shoulders...
With Emu on her shoulders. That might just do it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know what you're talking about!
It's like a thigh stand from group gymnastics! They did it at my school during our Sports Festival and it looked really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
W-Wait...!
I thought you only needed three people for that. And you don't usually have to have anyone on your shoulders...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Between not having any helpers as is normal during group gymnastics and this terrible footing, it is going to be dangerous. However, we should be fine as long as we keep our hands anchored to the tree.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can also lay down a bed of grass just in case as a cushion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: B-But I'd have to stand on top of you guys while having Emu on my shoulders... The thought of me dropping her's terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, Nene, why don't you sit on top with me in the middle? I promise to hold you tight and keep you steady!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That also sounds pretty tough...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Don't sweat it, Nene! You can do it!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Just imagine that you're the lead for a show!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yeah! It's like being the star on top of a Christmas tree! I know you'll do great, Nene☆>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I don't feel confident about this at all, but we won't be able to get those bananas if I don't try...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-Isn't there any other way...?!)
Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And now, I have to be the one on top...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (J-Just don't look down...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Are you ready, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah. I think so...
But go slow when you're about to stand, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
Alright, up you go.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
One, two...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, look at that...
It's like a giant cactus is sprouting from the ground.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <They're so high up!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How do you feel, Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
It's not as wobbly as I thought it would be and I can hold onto the tree, so it might not be so bad after all...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still can't quite reach the bananas... I might be able to if I try standing a little...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, what if I lose my balance...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sorry, but I need to tell you all something...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you need to tell us, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We have an emergency...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I need to sneeze.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh dear.
You sneeze with quite a bit of force, Tsukasa, so you'll make our formation collapse like a house of cards.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, please!
Just hold it in!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I-Isn't there anything we can do to stop him?!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Uhh... Hang on... I know!
Let's try a tongue twister! Repeat after me!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers! A peck of pickled peppers Peter Piper picked! And... Go!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Peter Piper... Pecked... Hm?>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Pickled peppers...!
Arrgh...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Th-That didn't work, did it?!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <It may've actually made things worse...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Please...
J-Just hold out a little longer!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I have to hurry up and get them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm the only one who can right now...!
I don't have time to be afraid...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, there's no need to rush...
I can keep this sneeze at bay for a while longer...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I can... Uh oh...
Keep it at... Bay!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh geez...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's nearing his limit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-If Tsukasa's sneeze makes us fall, Nene, I promise to catch you on the way down!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, so will I...
Also, we set up that nice bed of grass just in case something like this happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So just try to focus on getting those bananas. You have nothing else to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's not just Tsukasa. Emu's shoulders are shaking a lot now and Rui's probably got it the worst right now. But they're doing their best to keep me calm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to be brave...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui and Tsukasa picked herbs for us, and Emu found all those berries. I'm the only one who still hasn't made any contributions.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to do what I can for them...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just hang with me for a little longer, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, Nene, are you standing up...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
O-Only just a little bit...
Can you guys move a hair to the right for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay.
You may feel a wobble.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How's that? Can you get them?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think I can...
se_event_island_2022_013

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I got them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Achooo!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haha☆
That was such a big sneeze, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Sweet relief. I apologize for causing such a big fuss...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Honestly, I wasn't sure how things would turn out there...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In retrospect, it may've been easier for us to come back down, let Tsukasa sneeze and redo what we were doing...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Definitely!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why didn't you say that sooner...?
But I guess we at least managed to get what we were after...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They look good enough to be sold at a fancy department store!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They still seem a little unripe.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But they should still be edible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I see five bananas, so that's one for each person!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Good work, Nene!
Now we don't have to go hungry!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
This should be enough to fill our bellies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was only able to get them because you guys held on for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm glad I could help...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, now that we have our staple, we can start making our way back towards where Shosuke and Robo-Nene are.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
He's probably really starving right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What was that sound...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wh-What was it...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Um, over there...?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?
Ooooook!!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Eek!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What was that blur?!
It looked like it was trying to attack you, Nene... Are you alright?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
But the bananas...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The monkeys took them...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook ook...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: <Monkeys?!>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What is it, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry to interrupt this conversation, but I thought I saw something pass through those bushes just now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may've been these monkeys.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now's not the time for that!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Oook, ook...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no!
The monkeys are running away!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And didn't some just slap their behinds while staring right at us?! You all saw that, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They were definitely taunting us.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <If we don't do something, those monkeys are gonna eat the bananas Nene worked so hard to get!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wh-What do we do?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do we do...?
They took them, so I'm not sure there's anything we can...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We have to act!
Let's go after them right now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They'll regret ever taking our precious bananas from us!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yay! We get to play tag with the monkeys♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Alright...
I guess we should follow suit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're kidding, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook♪ Ook♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Grr... I know they can't speak, but it's like they're saying, “Catch us if you can!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'm not about to give up! Not after coming this far!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're really serious about getting them back...? They're wild monkeys... What if we get hurt...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I am not about to lose to the likes of these monkeys!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I have every reason to be worried!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But theft is theft.
The herbs and berries are one thing, but they took what we hoped would keep us going.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They might be hungry too, so we could share...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we can't just let them take what we worked so hard to get!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I get that...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And there's no guarantee that chasing after these monkeys will result in us getting our bananas back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
...!
Exactly. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've come up with a little plan.

rows.Speaker: Nene, Tsukasa & Emu
rows.Line: What?
Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Oooook...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Finally, I've got you cornered...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Give up and prepare to be captured...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come! Here! You!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook! Ook! Ooook♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa, you didn't get any of them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I know!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... They won't stop moving...
And I get the feeling that they're making fun of me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they don't seem to be taking our efforts seriously.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bah... After spending so much energy running here too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Argh... That's enough!
Forget the bananas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What?!
But we came all this way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What choice do we have?
Nene was right. City kids like us don't stand a chance against these monkeys' natural toughness.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
And it's not like we lost everything...
We still have a bucket full of wild herbs and berries!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Listen, Nene.
You absolutely need to protect this bucket. We can't afford to have our lifeline get stolen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
I know...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Now, let's head back!
I'm sure Shosuke's worked up quite an appetite and is eagerly awaiting our return!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right. I'll also...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I've come up with a little plan.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
These monkeys seem very smart.
I think they've been closely observing our actions and how we talk.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, we may actually be able to fight by doing what we're best at...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What we're best at...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, do you mean acting?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, we can do a little skit.
Here's my plan...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: When we corner them, we'll act like we're giving up. Then, we'll say, “We don't need those bananas,” and show them that we still have a bucket full of food.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My guess is that they'll try to take our bucket along with the bananas, which is when we'll let loose our trap.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We can capture the monkeys by throwing a net over them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I see.
But how do you plan on getting a net?>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought we could make one out of the vine I picked up earlier and some of the torn fishing nets that I found along the coast.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we can somehow get it to land on top of the monkeys, our plan will succeed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, that plan sounds perfect!
Now, who do you need doing what?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll need you to egg the monkeys on, Tsukasa. As for the crucial role of the person holding the bucket...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene, I'd like to ask you to be the one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that means Nene gets to be the star again!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, why me...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because the monkeys took the bananas from you. If they see you again, they may believe that they'll be able to steal whatever else you're carrying.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You and I will be in charge of casting the net, Emu. While you carefully show the monkeys what's in our bucket, Nene, we'll need you to somehow lure them towards us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And when they get close enough, we'll jump out and capture them with our net!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay, I understand the plan, but these are wild monkeys we're talking about...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'm sure you'll do just fine, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<I know you must be very scared.
I mean, it's not like you go around chasing after wild monkeys on a day-to-day basis.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I know you're able to take on even scarier challenges, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even scarier...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about when I got those bananas down...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, that too!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I was talking about something closer to home. And it's not just Nene. It's something that Tsukasa, the others and I have experienced before several times.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Are you talking about our shows...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Correct♪
The moment before you go on stage is always a little scary because you're worried about how things will go and how the audience will react, right?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <But I've seen you overcome that countless times, Nene!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <She's right...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You must've also had to muster up quite a bit of courage to start performing on stage again after taking a break from it, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And the way you ad-libbed a song after Robo-Nene malfunctioned was so wonderful too...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: L-Look, I appreciate what you're all trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Standing on stage can be scary, but trying to fool some monkeys seems like a different story.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But they sorta have a point. The tension in the air before the curtains go up, being scared of forgetting my lines or worrying about staying in pitch during a song...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Compared to all that, this is...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll be fine, Nene. Because...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <All you have to do is remember everything that you went through and think about how you were able to overcome all those situations...!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I've gotta be brave...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can do this. I mean...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(They're all here with me.
So I should be fine this time too...!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Come here...!)
Desert Island - Jungle

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, we have them now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, they're in a good position just as we expected. Our plan is sure to succeed now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ready, Rui?!
One, two...!
se_event_island_2022_014

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, how'd it go?! Did we get them?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Did it work?!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line:
Oook!
Oooook!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I didn't think we'd be able to capture all of the monkeys, but we did it. Our trap worked like a charm.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<That was amazing!
Your acting almost had me fooled, Tsukasa!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Rui and Emu were perfectly in sync when they cast the net too.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
They all did a great job.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So did you, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Yes, you did!
My heart started racing when those monkeys started going after you!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I did it...
Even though I didn't think I could...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, now that we've recovered our bananas, we need to decide what to do about our primate friends here...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
I have a suggestion as the captain of the berry-hunting brigade!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, these are the monkeys that stole our bananas!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I think they did that because they were hungry too... So, I thought we could share some of our berries with them!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
I'm sure they've learned their lesson after being caught like this, but we may also be at fault for encroaching upon their territory.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Emu, that grassy tunnel you found earlier may've been made by these monkeys.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I think you're right!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook... Ook...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's partly our fault that this happened, so we should let them go. They're probably all terrified right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, the net's off. You're free now.
Also, here are some berries as a present from Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can't give you our bananas, but we're hoping that these will keep you full for a little bit...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line:
Ook...
Oook!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hey, they ran!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Even after sharing some of our food with them. As ungrateful as they seem, I suppose they're still just wild animals...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, that may not be the case.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook! Oook!
se_event_island_2022_007

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Whoa!
They came back... But...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Look☆ They brought lots of fruits with them!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh wow...
This must be their gift to all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook, oook!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-There's so much...
What should I do?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. They seem to have taken quite a liking to you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I say accept their kindness.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay... In that case...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hang on. If they had this much food already, then they must've taken your bananas because...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They were hoping that we'd play with them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That's incredible.
So this is their way of thanking you for playing tag with them?!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Their way of thanking us...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you so much, monkeys!
We really appreciate it♪

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ooook!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
However...
We ended up spending quite a lot of time just trying to gather food.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we did. The sun's already starting to set, so we should start making our way out of this jungle.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Especially since Shosuke's probably super starving now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's a shame that we must leave after just becoming friends, but alas, we have no choice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Farewell, jungle friends!
Let us meet again someday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Monkeys
rows.Line: Ook ook!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I never thought that I'd end up meeting some monkeys on a desert island. I was so scared at first too since we were dealing with wild animals...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I guess they were kinda cute...)
Beach

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Welcome back, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're back, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Did anything interesting happen while we were gone?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Nothing in particular.
I have gathered everything we will need to set up camp. I also caught some small crabs and clams.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Crabs and clams!
That's great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Looks like we'll be feasting tonight!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on. We went into the jungle to look for food because we were a little hungry. We ended up spending so much time in there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
I'd totally forgotten because of everything that happened to us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Who knew that we'd end up playing tag with all those monkeys...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fortunately, we managed to gather the food and water we needed, so let's start preparing dinner and getting ready to spend the night by setting up camp in that cave we found.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If it gets any darker, it's going to become very difficult to do much of anything, and it certainly won't be safe to go back into the jungle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, the jungle at night does sound very scary. Let's go find Shosuke and start getting ready...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on. Where is he...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shosuke has been inside the cruiser this whole time. I tried to help, but he told me to keep gathering food...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So he was trying to fix the radio the entire time we were in the jungle?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It must've been very broken.
He may still be trying to fix it for us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, let's leave him to that while we get everything else set up...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's surprise him by getting a really amazing base camp set up!
Coast
se_event_island_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should do it for the food...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It still needs to cook for a bit, but how are you guys doing over there...?
se_event_island_2022_010

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Where'd that big tent come from?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hah hah hah hah!
What do you think?! Amazing, no?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The cave's a little cramped, so we decided to make that our sleeping area and this our living space!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We even have some space set up where we can hang our laundry in case we have to stay here for longer than we expect.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Finally, behold, this hammock!
What better way is there to enjoy our desert island vacation?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so cool!
It's like our very own hideout! I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, I tried my hand at making a sundial. I'm sure it'll be nice to have a way for us to tell the time.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, isn't a sundial pretty simple? You just need the sun to cast a shadow in the right way to tell the time, right? This looks oddly ornate...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought that just making one out of the leftover sticks we had would be a little dull, so I decided to put my skills to the test by making some wood carvings using some rocks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You had time to do all that...?
What happened to this being a survival adventure?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Do you prefer a more “surviving on the edge” feel? If so, we'll have to throw comfort out the window...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think it just means Nene's in a place mentally where she can enjoy something like that now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I might have MEIKO and the others to thank for that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Speaking of which, I haven't heard Miku or the others say anything for a while now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, you're right.
My phone's right here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Its battery ran out?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It was on this entire time, so I suppose this was inevitable.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They're probably very worried about us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we couldn't use this to call for help anyway, so it's not actually a problem!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right.
Although, I was sort of hoping to thank MEIKO for what she said.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, after we get back, we can just tell them all about everything that happened!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I dunno...
It's like everything's been turned upside down.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I realized that we were stranded, I was so worried that we wouldn't be able to get back or what was gonna happen to us and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm standing here right now with my phone and feel the same way as Tsukasa since it's not really of any use to us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just a little while ago, I would've been absolutely terrified by that thought.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Nene, you're smiling!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's no need to worry!
We have plenty of food and managed to set up a spectacular base camp.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anything is possible when it comes to us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I agree...
I believe we're able to enjoy this situation now because we're all together.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Washing up on a desert island alone seemed unthinkable, but we ended up facing one crazy thing after another... Like foraging for bananas and capturing monkeys...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But looking back, it totally sounds like something we'd do... Something that would only happen with the four of us...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, I guess this is kind of like our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Rui would try out an effect and send Tsukasa flying, or Emu would unexpectedly pop out of nowhere... Just so many ridiculous things...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But it always feels like we can do anything whenever we work together...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even though it seems so stupid sometimes...)

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? What the?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This camp you've set up looks incredible. Do you plan on living here from now on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! Shosuke, you're here?!
We wanted to surprise you with this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: How's the radio looking?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Broken as expected...
I've been trying to fix it since it's been showing signs of life, but I'll need until tomorrow morning at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Would you like a hand?
I'm sure it'll be better if we...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: No, you still might have to put on your show. I can sleep all I want once the radio's fixed.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you plan on working through the night? I'm not sure pushing yourself so hard is such a...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I disagree. This is exactly when I should be pushing myself because fixing this radio opens up the possibility of being rescued and getting you all to put on your show as scheduled.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (He really spent the entire day trying to fix the radio...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If that's the case, he deserves to have as much of the food we gathered as he wants.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, since we're all here, why don't we start having dinner...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Everything should be just about done!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm sure we're all starving, so let's be thankful for this bounty!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Ready, everyone?!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
H-How is it?
It was my first time making this, so I wasn't really sure how it would turn out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Super wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this soup is delicious. You did a wonderful job of drawing the flavor out of these clams and crabs. It's incredible gourmet for desert island cuisine.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The fruits and berries go strangely well together in this stew too. The fruits in particular seem to be doing a good job of balancing out all the flavors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
They like the fun and exciting recipes that Nene and I came up with!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. This is so nice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Our dishes turned out so delicious and specially wonderhoy even though we sort of just threw everything we had together! I can't help but smile from ear to ear because of how happy I am...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Specially wonderhoy...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I sort of get what she means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I also understand.
Emu here is trying to say that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We couldn't have asked for a better dinner!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be honest, it would've been better if we knew that we'd be doing our show tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry.
It's my fault that we're in this mess at all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Shosuke...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I should've known that the weather wouldn't hold up before we left. For safety's sake, I could've even had you fly there instead.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: If anything, I unwisely chose to take you there on my cruiser because I wanted to give all of you a reward and a chance to relax for contributing so much to Phoenix Wonderland... It was all a mistake...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, it wasn't a mistake!
Going on your cruiser was really fun since it'd been so long since I last did!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu's right!
If anything, we wouldn't be putting on shows as park ambassadors right now if it weren't for you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. We couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Look at me, crying over spilled milk.
Alright, it's your turn to tell a story next. It's not often that you get to chat while sitting around a campfire like this...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A story, eh...?
For me, the shows we've done as ambassadors up to this point are what immediately come to mind.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, same.
We got to experience so much, and just recently, Tsukasa did an amazing job as Thorpe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I struggled quite a lot with a role, but it ended up being fun since it was so different from the characters I usually play...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! You really shined that time, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was also blown away by your performance, Tsukasa. I believe only you can play the version of Thorpe we all know.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And the show before that...
It was the one we did at my grandpa's house!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, we were able to put on the show that I'd been dreaming of doing in the best way imaginable, so I couldn't have been happier.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But our first show also left a big impression on me. The one about the Little Mermaid and how Nene's ad-libbing saved the day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was so awesome!
Her singing voice was so pretty too! I almost thought that she was the real Little Mermaid!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's our songstress for you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When you guys put it that way, I can't help but feel a bit embarrassed... Still, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In retrospect, these ambassadorial shows have been quite a boon for us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, they have!
But we can't be satisfied with just this! After all, my dream is to become a star of the showbiz world!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, me next! Me next!
My dream's to make lots and lots of people smile like my grandpa used to say♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe...
You don't have to tell us twice. We already know what your dreams are, Tsukasa, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then, what's your dream?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, we've never really asked you that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's true...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My dream is to put on a show that can make everyone smile with effects that nobody's ever seen before.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A show that makes people from all walks of life smile regardless of who they are, where they're from or what language they speak...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That's such a great dream!
It's kinda like mine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, Rui, that dream suits you very well!
But please try not to go too far with your experiments...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I'm sure they already knew...
But I really wasn't expecting Rui to state what his dream is out loud like this...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And last but not least, Nene!
What's your dream...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My dream...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I loved singing so much, but one mistake made me shy away from it...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But doing shows with everyone reminded me of just how much fun it is to sing on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I absolutely love doing shows.
They put a smile on my face, so it'd be great if I could do the same for everyone around the world...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: My dream's to become a musical actress.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-One who travels around the world...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?! You too, Nene?!
You also wish to see the world?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That means if we both make our dreams come true, we may get a chance to work together on something!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
The chances of that happening seem slim...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it'd be great if that actually happened.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The thought of Nene's wonderful singing voice and Tsukasa's incredible acting skills making people the world over smile... Hehe. It's all very exciting.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is!
What kinds of shows do you wanna do on the world's stages? I'd love to see you guys perform!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Interesting...
I didn't realize that you all had so many concrete plans about the future.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
That didn't come out right.
It's just... Well, I'm surprised is all.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I was under the impression that you'd want to keep doing shows together for as long as possible.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(H-He has a point...
In order to make our individual dreams come true, we'll have to...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the time we do achieve our dreams, we'll likely be performing on separate stages.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A different stage... Not the one we've all come to call our home...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't want that to happen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I absolutely want you guys to make your dreams come true since they're all so shiny and sparkly...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Still...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thought of us not being able to do shows together is kinda sad...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, it is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I have my dream because of them.
They were the ones who helped me remember just how much fun it is to do shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even today, they helped me overcome my fears, and yet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't imagine what it's gonna be like when we go our separate ways...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They all feel the same way...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <However, I have a good feeling that this experience will turn into something invaluable later on!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(When that does happen...
I have a feeling it won't be all that sad...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nene...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yes, we probably will have to go our separate ways in order to pursue our dreams...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thought of that happening is really sad and makes my heart sink...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But when that happens...
I have a feeling that it'll be the moment when we take a big step towards achieving our goals...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, when that happens... I'd like it if we could all smile and laugh in support of one another...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I... I think that there are a lot of things we can do because we're Wonderlands×Showtime, and that we'll have done so much together by then!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And that won't change even after we go our separate ways to pursue our dreams...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not really sure how to describe it... But I believe those things will remain with us forever...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And until that time comes, I want to cherish the shows that we're able to do together...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All the shows we thought would be too hard, all the shows we thought wouldn't be possible... I wanna try as many of them as we can!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: All of us... Together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nene's absolutely right...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The road to achieving our dreams will be long and treacherous! In other words, taking steps towards that will be no small feat!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we'll surely encounter plenty of hurdles along the way.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, we are Wonderlands×Showtime. The troupe that's already accomplished what others called impossible! That is why I believe we can take on any challenge that's thrown at us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whatever the future has in store for us...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's keep doing our best!
And think about what we can do for our next ambassadorial performance!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's take Nene's words to heart and keep doing everything we possibly can together!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For the sake of our futures!
The next day
Coast

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is it morning already...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mhm... Nene...
You shouldn't eat that gingerbread house... The witch covered it in hot mustard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez, Emu.
What kind of dream are you...?
